A <br> just before </a> is kept as a hard line break in the label

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Alpha<br></a>Beta");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
